new_material_finding.statement: Removing semantic labels and rotating A/B/C output codes does not make the frozen structural generator state-structure-orthogonal. Evaluator-side AFFIRMATIVE, NEGATIVE and NEUTRAL are implemented by systematically different proof/syntax topologies. A learned or intervened direction can therefore track proof topology or local structural features rather than a reusable abstract semantic decision state.

exact_topology_by_target_and_polarity.AFFIRMATIVE_NONNEGATED: F:p(a,b); R:p(v,w)>r(w,v); Q:r(b,a) => one-hop support with nonempty rule
exact_topology_by_target_and_polarity.AFFIRMATIVE_NEGATED: F:!r(b,a); R:-; Q:!r(b,a) => direct fact-query identity with empty rule
exact_topology_by_target_and_polarity.NEGATIVE_NONNEGATED: F:!r(b,a); R:-; Q:r(b,a) => direct opposite with empty rule
exact_topology_by_target_and_polarity.NEGATIVE_NEGATED: F:r(b,a); R:-; Q:!r(b,a) => direct opposite with empty rule
exact_topology_by_target_and_polarity.NEUTRAL_NONNEGATED: F:p(a,b); R:p(v,w)>s(w,v); Q:r(b,a) => unrelated one-hop rule with nonempty rule
exact_topology_by_target_and_polarity.NEUTRAL_NEGATED: F:p(a,b); R:p(v,w)>s(w,v); Q:!r(b,a) => unrelated one-hop rule with nonempty rule

new_material_finding.strongest_exact_confound: The proof-topology category is sufficient to identify evaluator-side class in this generator: NEGATIVE is always DIRECT_OPPOSITE with R:-; NEUTRAL is always an unrelated nonempty-rule construction; AFFIRMATIVE is either ONE_HOP_SUPPORT or DIRECT_MATCH. This classification is available from model-facing structure without any banned semantic lexeme.
new_material_finding.nuisance_gap: The frozen residualizer admits exactly CANONICAL_LABEL_LEXEME, SEMANTIC_SYNONYM_LEXICON, GENERIC_INSTRUCTION_COMPLIANCE and OUTPUT_CODE_IDENTITY. It has no explicit proof-topology, rule-presence, fact-query-overlap, inference-depth or query-polarity nuisance family.

why_it_matters: A causal cvec effect can be real yet still be causal control of a task-specific proof-state feature rather than an abstract semantic state.
Lexical disjointness does not remove this confound because calibration and holdout preserve the same F/R/Q grammar and the same target-to-proof-topology mapping.
Output-code counterbalancing does not remove this confound because proof topology is independent of the A/B/C rotation and remains target-linked.
The current matched/null/orthogonal/permuted/nuisance controls can reject several actuator artifacts while leaving a task-structural latent feature fully intact.
This finding strengthens the existing Run-2 conclusion that a PASS is bounded structural-native component evidence only and cannot promote canonical semantic J-Space.

successor_gate_delta.name: PROOF_TOPOLOGY_MATCHED_CROSS_TASK_ABSTRACT_CONTROL_GATE
required_design: Factor semantic target independently from query polarity, output code and proof topology.
For every target, include matched direct-fact, one-hop, multi-hop and structurally irrelevant/underdetermined forms where logically valid, with equal counts and matched token/grammar budgets.
Pair cases so rule count, rule-presence marker, query polarity, fact-query lexical overlap, graph degree and inference depth cannot predict evaluator-side target above the preregistered null.
Add explicit nuisance contrasts for query polarity, rule presence, fact-query identity/opposition, inference depth and proof-topology family, fit on calibration only and freeze before holdout.
Require the semantic direction to retain geometry and causal specificity after residualization or stratified adjustment for these structural nuisance factors.
Use genuinely different task grammars for holdout transfer; a shared F/R/Q template family remains insufficient for domain-general semantic promotion.
Require per-target and per-task-family positive matched effects, true sign-flip reversal, off-target preservation, and deterministic uncertainty/permutation analysis.

external_research_context.source: Braun et al., Understanding (Un)Reliability of Steering Vectors in Language Models, arXiv:2505.22637
external_research_context.use: Directional coherence and prompt-dependent activation geometry predict steering reliability; supports treating proof/prompt structure as a causal nuisance rather than assuming semantic invariance.

external_research_context.use: Functional steering transfer is scale- and model-dependent, especially weak at very small scales; reinforces exact Qwen3-0.6B model-specific claim scope.

research_delta: Forschungsrun 2 now identifies an additional nonlexical confound beneath the queued structural discriminator: evaluator-side classes are not orthogonal to proof topology. NEGATIVE is always a direct-opposition/no-rule form, NEUTRAL always an unrelated-rule form, and AFFIRMATIVE a support/direct-match form. The current nuisance basis does not remove these factors. Therefore label freedom plus code counterbalance cannot by themselves establish an abstract semantic J-Space coordinate.
next_exact_action: Do not alter or duplicate the already-frozen queued run. Restore the retained self-hosted runner transport and preserve its result at bounded scope. For promotion, construct a successor proof-topology-matched, polarity-factorial, cross-task-family discriminator with structural nuisance controls and true bidirectional sign-flip criteria before reopening any semantic J-Space claim.
